Reconnect, Restore, & Renew
Experience one of the best Mental Health Treatment Centers in New Jersey
Welcome to Garden Springs Wellness Center, where bespoke treatment meets integrative care in an effort to provide New Jersey's best mental health treatment programs designed for lasting wellness.

Through our evidence-based approaches and compassionate, client-centered philosophies, Garden Springs Wellness Center offers New Jersey residents access to high-quality, personalized mental health treatment at our Englewood, New Jersey facilities. Discover why Garden Springs Wellness is your best choice when looking for an in-depth, transformative experience in mental healthcare.

Innovating, Customized Behavioral Healthcare
Our treatment program was hand-crafted by the top mental health professionals in the TriState area, offering you the latest advancements in mental healthcare.

We work with most major commercial PPO & POS insurance plans to help cover many of the costs associated with treatment at Garden Springs Wellness Center. Get a free verification of benefits and learn more about your personal options for treatment.
Advanced Therapeutic Solutions

Our interventional approach to mental health treatment combines traditional treatments with cutting-edge therapies in order to provide you with the most effective mental health treatment available in the TriState area.
Our expert team of experienced doctors, clinicians, and mental health professionals are here to help you on your journey to mental health & wellness.
Explore Our Modern Mental Health Facility in New Jersey
Our modern, newly-renovated facilities in Englewood, New Jersey offer you easy access from major North Jersey highways and include a variety of features and amenities such as:

Our newly remodeled group rooms provide a calming and safe space where our client can focus on healing from their mental health issues. From our comfortable seating to modern technology used throughout the facility, Garden Springs Wellness offers you the best of the best when seeking mental health treatment in NJ.
Our therapy suites are fitted with the latest advancements in technology and interior design to provide soundproof experiences so you can trust your therapy sessions are just yours.
We are proud to offer a number of wellness-driven activities and therapies including yoga, meditation groups, mindfulness CBT, sound therapy, and much more.
Our facility is also uniquely designed with aromatherapy built into our central unit in order to provide a continuously relaxed and welcoming environment that promotes wellness at every turn.
To schedule a tour or to learn more about the admissions process at Garden Springs Wellness Center, contact us today.
